headline: Goldman Sachs downgrades Mazagon Dock and GRSE
hook: Goldman Sachs initiates sell ratings on defence
summary: Goldman Sachs initiated a 'Sell' rating on Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders and Garden Reach Shipbuilders, citing concerns over slowing earnings growth and order book exhaustion. The brokerage projects EBITDA declines through FY29 and set price targets implying 7% and 24% downsides respectively. Shares of both companies fell over 5% following the report. This bearish outlook contrasts with broader analyst consensus, which maintains significant upside potential for both stocks.
why_it_matters: Valuation concerns may trigger profit booking in high-flying defence stocks.
winners_losers: Goldman Sachs gains / Defence shareholders hurt

headline: Goldman Sachs bets against Mazagon Dock and GRSE amid warship surge
summary: India is experiencing a surge in warship orders. Goldman Sachs has taken a short position on Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd and Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd. The move could weigh on the share prices of these defence shipbuilders.
why_it_matters: Potential stock dip for defence shipbuilders

headline: Goldman Sachs issues 'Sell' ratings on Garden Reach and Mazagon Dock, causing shares to fall
hook: Brokerage cuts target prices for defence majors
summary: Goldman Sachs initiated coverage on Indian defence shipbuilders Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers and Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders with 'Sell' ratings. The brokerage set a target price of Rs 1,515 for GRSE, suggesting a 25 per cent downside, and Rs 1,855 for Mazagon Dock. Following the downgrade, shares of both companies fell by up to 8 per cent in trade. Retail investors holding these PSU defence stocks should note the bearish institutional sentiment after a massive run-up in valuations.
why_it_matters: Valuation pressure hits high-flying defence PSU stocks

headline: Goldman Sachs issues bearish call on defence stocks Mazagon Dock and Garden Reach
hook: Goldman Sachs flags more downside for shipbuilders
summary: Goldman Sachs has issued a bearish call on Indian defence stocks Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders and Garden Reach Shipbuilders. Shares of both companies have already corrected between 35% to 42% from their respective 52-week highs. Despite the recent pullbacks, the brokerage sees further downside risk ahead based on three key reasons. Retail investors holding public sector defence stocks should review their exposure amid growing brokerage caution.
why_it_matters: Defence portfolio holdings face continued correction pressure from brokerages.

hook: Indian Navy expands shallow-water anti-submarine fleet

The project is part of the government's 'Make in India' initiative to bolster domestic naval manufacturing capabilities. The induction strengthens coastal surveillance and defense infrastructure.
